title: National and State-Level Approaches to Automated Vehicle Certification: A Comparative Framework for State Operational Governance
description:
arXiv:2611.08681v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Automated vehicle (AV) deployment in the United States is expanding without a unified federal certification framework, leading to substantial variation in how states authorize and oversee AV testing and deployment.
